_doc: Per-host pacing for wayback.host_get (D5, scripts/world-law/COVERAGE-WAVE.md, 'Decisions applied 2026-11-02'). Keys: exact host, the host without 'www.', or '*.parent.domain'. tier A = the site states a rate (give 'interval' seconds or 'rate' requests/s, and 'source'); B = force the 3-day ramp to 1/s; C = 1 per 3 s; stop = never request this host. 'daily' overrides the 5,000 cap. Hosts not listed start at the C pace and move to B (or A from a robots Crawl-delay) after 20 clean responses and a robots.txt read; any bot-management header or cookie makes them C for good, and any challenge stops them for good (stop file in %LOCALAPPDATA%/gitlaw/host-stops). A slower robots Crawl-delay always wins. Sources: global-law-unblock-report.html (2026-11-02) and the scraper logs.
